text: This statue here looks like it depicts something of the Goddess Savia.
She is said to protect travelers savely on the road.
Perhaps praying to it would make you save?

choices.text: *Kneel down and pray to the statue.* [BLUE](Save game)
*You don't believe in such heathen things. Leave it be.*

text: Whether you believe in her or not, Savia's protection is said to be real.
The fire has burned down to charred wood, still smoking.
One might think a tree was cut down here.
